release_notes:
1. Resolved Spurious view_item: Fixed race condition where updatedProduct was triggered after add_to_cart, adding 2500ms cart cooldown and combination attribute verification.
2. Fixed Empty view_item_list: Prevents empty dataLayer emissions on category listings without products.
3. Advertising Platform Settings: Added Back Office settings panel with Master toggle, platform switches (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads), interactive 11-event routing matrix with Select/Deselect All convenience controls, and spec tooltips.
